name: W New York Times Square
positioning: W New York - Times Square: a high-energy hotel above Broadway in Midtown Manhattan, with high-floor suites over Times Square and a Living Room bar that pays tribute to the old Times Square
best_for: Theater-goers who want Broadway and Hell's Kitchen on the doorstep
Travelers who want Times Square views and a lively bar scene

facts.text: The hotel is steps from major subway lines in Manhattan.
Nearby attractions include the Theater District, the Museum of Modern Art, Central Park and Radio City Music Hall.
Many observation decks are within walking distance of the hotel.
Oversized windows in the rooms frame panoramic views of New York.
Each room has a W signature bed with a pillowtop mattress and 350-thread-count sheets, and a bathroom with Davines amenities.
Some high-floor corner king rooms have Times Square views.
Blue Fin is a two-floor seafood restaurant with a street-level sushi bar, an upper-level cocktail bar and two private dining rooms.
The FIT gym is available to guests 24/7.
Pets receive a W pet bed, pet toys and a turndown treat.
The closest airport is LaGuardia Airport.

highlights.text: The hotel soars above a stretch of Broadway in the heart of Midtown Manhattan, moments from Broadway's theaters and the restaurants and bars of Hell's Kitchen.
From the Extreme WOW Penthouse Suite, Times Square's lights are at your feet with panoramic views.
The Extreme WOW Two Bedroom Suite sits on the hotel's upper floors with views of the New York City skyline.
The Living Room, a playful tribute to the Times Square of the past, has a bar with cabanas, live DJs and curated cocktails.
The Broadway Meet + Greet Cocktail Hour offers an intimate experience with a Broadway actor in The Living Room Bar.

considerations.text: The hotel's official wellness partner is Sage + Sound, a studio on the Upper East Side offering acupuncture, massage and facials.
WhataHotel notes the high-energy atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
